title: indigo_agent_scheduler: list AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY oldest first
description:
AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY lists the finished runs newest first, while AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN lists the coming runs in time order. The owner finds oldest first more logical for the history, so the property reads chronologically like the plan.

Change: update_history_property() in indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler.c emits the items oldest first, newest last. Each entry keeps its item name RUN_<serial>. When the history is full (200), the oldest entry drops off the top. The internal array order, the saved/restored history text (AGENT_SCHEDULER_RESTORE_HISTORY) and CLEAR behaviour stay as they are.

Update the tests in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c that index history items by position, add a test that checks the order (oldest first) including the case when the history is full, and update the docs that say "newest first": indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md (lines 361 and 694), indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md (line 793), indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md (AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY row) and the comment at indigo_agent_scheduler.c:675. Bump DRIVER_VERSION.

outcome.summary: Code, version bump (0x03000012 -> 0x03000013), PROPERTIES.md, SCHEDULER.md and comment are correct; item names RUN_<serial> preserved, saved text and CLEAR unchanged. New test history_lists_oldest_first covers order, names, lights and the full-history drop-off; full test_agent_scheduler suite 112/112 passed locally. Defects: (1) indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:796-799 - the example block directly under the changed sentence still lists the runs newest first (2026-11-21 01:28 first, 2026-11-20 20:02 Evening hook last); reverse the four lines so the example matches 'oldest first, newest last'. (2) tools/scheduler_sandbox.py:463 - 'history [N]' prints items[:count], which used to be the N most recent runs and now prints the N oldest of up to 200; use items[-count:] (or state the changed meaning). Item 2 is a consumer of the changed order outside the file list of the ticket; if the owner considers it out of scope, register it separately instead.

Round 2: both round-1 findings fixed. INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:796-799 example now oldest first; tools/scheduler_sandbox.py:463-464 'history [N]' prints the N most recent runs (items[max(len-count,0):]). update_history_property() reverses only the published order; item names RUN_<serial> and lights stay with their entries; array, history_text/restore_history and CLEAR unchanged. DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000012 -> 0x03000013. Docs consistent: SCHEDULER.md:361,694, GUIDE:793, PROPERTIES.md:706, source comment at :675; no other repo consumer depends on the order (git grep for AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY: only the sandbox). Tests: history_records_runs indices updated correctly; new history_lists_oldest_first checks order, names, lights for 205 restored entries (cap 200) and appending past the cap. Ran test_agent_scheduler: history_* 5x 2/2 pass; full suite 112/112 on the second run, the first run had 1 unidentified failure (output filtered), not reproduced, history cases stable.
